title: Minkowski's Convex Body Theorem and Integer Programming
relevance: Primary exact-CVP worst-case theorem: Theorem 4.5 (§4, p. 430) gives O(r^r s) arithmetic operations for input length s and bounds intermediate rational bit lengths by O(r²(s + log r)); the problem has a rational basis and target. This yields r^{O(r)} poly(s) bit time. Applying it to rational Gram-only input uses the same exact inner-product computations and is a representation-level inference, since the theorem states the coordinate-input model.

title: A bound on the k-gonality of facets of the hypermetric cone and related complexity problems
authors: Avis, David and Grishukhin, Viacheslav P.
relevance: Primary source for the named hypermetricity test: §4, P6 asks whether an integer metric is hypermetric and labels its complexity unknown. The paper proves co-NP membership and hardness for bounded-gonality testing/minimum violated gonality, not unrestricted hypermetricity hardness.

title: Hypermetrics in Geometry of Numbers
authors: Deza, Michel and Grishukhin, Viacheslav P. and Laurent, Monique
relevance: Primary geometric source connecting hypermetrics and L-polytopes/empty ellipsoids (§§2–3). It supports the circumsphere-membership formulation, but does not establish hardness of that test.

title: The Boolean quadric polytope
venue: The Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization Problem: Theory, Algorithms, and Applications, chapter 4, 97–120
relevance: Recent survey status check: §7.2 reports the separation complexity of hypermetric inequalities and related BQP classes as unknown. It helps distinguish the already named problem from the hardness result supplied by the current reduction.
